title: Decode the HE-AAC core natively, reconstruct the extension separately

definition.title: Decode the HE-AAC core natively, reconstruct the extension separately
definition.source_excerpt: Extract valid AAC-LC core data from constrained HE-AAC v1, browser-decode it, then apply retained SBR reconstruction in a controlled stage. First check full native support and preserve sample interpretation and fidelity.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially changes an eligible file from an expensive/unsupported route to correct native or minimal-transform playback. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used.
definition.minimum_probe: Prerequisite-only first: Exact destination/configuration and existing source/worker assets; feature availability is not a pass for the complete route. If absent, record HOLD_ENV; if present, decide whether the small probe is warranted. Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.
